scope: Finite-resource Float64 service model; no RTL clock, SRAM macro, ASIC PPA or frozen-FP32 equivalence claim
weight_layout: q4-sector-major,c-major,4 adjacent h/word; bank=(c+sector)%8. One stored weight layout; q1 consumes one component of this word.
state_bank_ports: one shared read/write service per bank
source_transpose_cache_ports: 8x128bit read and independent write paths; row-to-column transpose is separately scheduled
wide_work_ports: 96 lane-local 64-bit read/write pairs, explicitly modeled register-bank capacity; not a foundry SRAM claim
moment_scratch_contents: Eight partial sum/sumsq pairs per h, two pending prefix thresholds, current affine coefficients and scalar parameters; q<=96
failure_bitmap_ports: one 128-bit read/write metadata service, bounded bitmap-window selector, two in-flight repair descriptors
policy: All axes provision the same resource superset, including otherwise idle packet/popcount auxiliaries. One main resource point, no automatic parameter sweep. Ordinary channel blocking and source/weight ordering are controls, not claimed innovations.
boundary: Packed captured source enters once and is retained to external backing, charged for every axis. Real checkpoint W is external readonly. End at final confirmed theta*g support/context delivery; FC2/BN2/shortcut and upstream source producer are outside this component.
